inspiration.title: Universal Paperclips
inspiration.note: The shape of the whole game: an incremental clicker that starts with one click and grows through automation and a multi-resource economy, here themed on the solar system.

other.title: Pyodide
other.note: Runs the game's Python rules in the browser through WebAssembly (version 0.26.4, loaded from a CDN), so the game needs no server of its own and no build step.
